name: io.github.Toraastrta/sphior-ai-governance-mcp
description: Record what your AI did as tamper-evident evidence for ISO 42001, EU AI Act and SOC 2. Hash-only.

environmentVariables.name: SPHIOR_AIGOV_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Ingestion token for your SPHIOR account. Without it the server still starts and tells you how to create one; no events are recorded until it is set. Create one at https://sphior.com/app?settings=aiingest

environmentVariables.name: SPHIOR_AIGOV_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Override the ingestion endpoint for self-hosted / regional deployments. Default: https://sphior.com/api/ai-governance/ingest
